protocol.controls: Unchanged, local gain, local EQ, constant whole-track offset, local 40 ms offset, insertion from a different speaker, local silence, both silent, an unchanged pair containing a deliberate short repeat, and same-content cross-codec pair comparisons.
protocol.delivery: Independent PCM WAV or AAC M4A encoding for each side. Compare only equal decoded length and relative start. Check unchanged WAV to FLAC and WAV to AAC separately on each utterance.
protocol.gate: No point fitting. Per codec require at least 30/48 correct, at least 12/24 for each sign, at least five held groups, zero alerts on unchanged, repeat, or whole-track shift, at most one total ordinary alert, and >=75% measured non-silent pairs.
protocol.schedule: Center on the independently predeclared publisher forced-phone endpoint. Clamp to leave 400 ms of flank at each side. No detector result selects clips or edit intervals.
protocol.scope: Same-waveform movement between two supplied recordings. Independent readback of derived source clocks, samples, and timing decisions. No speech origin, authenticity, or AI inference.
protocol.truth: Two 640 ms local moves, signed shifts of 160, 200, 240, or 280 ms. 5 ms linear crossfades preserve all outside samples. Reported range must cover at least 0.60 temporal IoU of the authored submitted span, with <=16 sample signed error.
